title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Anchored Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-Step LLM Agents

rs.key_step: 先按有独立verifier的turn分别groupstd，后用GT-conditioned selfteacher对token做方向一致、surprisal门控的有界放大。
rs.why_non_obvious: 隔开turn结果和token重要性，保scalar符号但不保共享参数整体梯度方向。
rs.trigger_condition: When independent turn outcomes are diluted by trajectory rewards, normalize credit by turn and gate teacher modulation within each turn.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When independent turn outcomes are diluted by trajectory rewards, normalize credit by turn and gate teacher modulation within each turn.

signatures.failure_boundary: 只有单trainingseed，3decode非3训练种子；surprisal只是重要性proxy；全错turn组adv为0并非负。

relevance.how: 独立turn verifier可减少跨请求稀释，crop多步共享终局需改造。
每turnstd消除共同scale且同质组为0。
